description: 1976 is the Year of the Fire Dragon in the Chinese zodiac, from January 31, 1976 to February 17, 1977. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1976 is the Year of the Fire Dragon, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on January 31, 1976 and ended on February 17, 1977, so people born in 1976 before Jan 31 belong to the Wood Rabbit year.

sections.heading: When the 1976 Fire Dragon year starts and ends
paragraphs: The 1976 Fire Dragon year began at Lunar New Year on January 31, 1976 and lasted until February 17, 1977, the day before the next new year. Anyone born between January 1 and Jan 31 1976 therefore belongs to the Wood Rabbit year that started in 1975, while someone born in early 1977, up to Feb 17, is still a Fire Dragon. The Chinese calendar is lunisolar, which is why the start date moves between January 21 and February 20 instead of staying on January 1. The same Fire Dragon combination also falls in 2036, sixty years apart, because five elements and twelve animals realign only once in each sixty-year cycle. Lunar New Year 1976 fell on a Saturday, while the Western Sun was in Aquarius.

sections.heading: Fire Dragon personality
paragraphs: Charismatic, idealistic and honest to the point of bluntness, the Fire Dragon aims high and acts decisively. Fire feeds the Dragon's Earth, which tradition reads as confidence amplified. People born in this year are often natural leaders. Impatience and a quick temper are the usual cautions, eased by waiting a night before voicing strong opinions. Their honesty, though sometimes blunt, is rarely malicious.

Fire is the element of summer and full daylight, and a Fire year is traditionally said to turn up the volume of whatever animal it meets. Descriptions link it with passion, charisma, courage and a love of movement and expression. Fire-year people are often portrayed as lively, persuasive and quick to act, able to warm a room and rally others behind an idea. The element is associated with the heart and with joy, which gives it real generosity of spirit. Its traditional shadow is impatience: Fire can burn hot and fast, leading to restlessness, sharp words in the moment and a tendency to lose interest once the excitement fades.

sections.heading: 1976 in numerology and the twelve-year cycle
paragraphs: In numerology the year reduces to 5, the number of change, freedom and movement, and a 5 year is usually described as restless and full of variety. The digits of 1976 add up to 23, which reduces to 5. In the twelve-year cycle the Dragon is the fifth animal, earthly branch Chen, with Earth as its fixed element and Yang polarity. The year element is Fire, and in the five-element cycles fire generates Earth. The year before was the Wood Rabbit and the year after is the Fire Snake.

In the traditional sexagenary count the year is called Bing-Chen: Bing is the Fire heavenly stem and Chen is the Dragon's earthly branch. Stems and branches alternate between yang and yin together, which is why yang stems only ever meet yang animals.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1976?
faq.answer: 1976 is the Year of the Fire Dragon. It started on January 31, 1976 and ended on February 17, 1977.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1976?
faq.answer: Check the date against Jan 31. Born before January 31, 1976, you are a Wood Rabbit; born on or after it, you are a Fire Dragon.

faq.question: What element is 1976 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Fire, a Yang year. The Dragon's own fixed element is Earth; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1976?
faq.answer: Bing-Chen. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Fire Dragon year?
faq.answer: 2036, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 2036.
